normalize_patient_id <- function(x) {
    substr(
        as.character(x),
        1,
        12
    )
}

normalize_sample_id <- function(x) {
    substr(
        as.character(x),
        1,
        16
    )
}

to_logical <- function(x) {

    if (is.logical(x)) {
        return(
            tidyr::replace_na(
                x,
                FALSE
            )
        )
    }

    x <- stringr::str_to_lower(
        trimws(
            as.character(x)
        )
    )

    result <- x %in% c(
        "true",
        "t",
        "1",
        "yes",
        "y"
    )

    result[is.na(result)] <- FALSE

    result
}

find_first_file <- function(
    directory,
    patterns
) {

    all_files <- list.files(
        directory,
        recursive = TRUE,
        full.names = TRUE
    )

    for (pattern in patterns) {

        matched <- all_files[
            stringr::str_detect(
                basename(all_files),
                regex(
                    pattern,
                    ignore_case = TRUE
                )
            )
        ]

        matched <- matched[
            !stringr::str_detect(
                matched,
                "MSS_TMBH_after_excluding"
            )
        ]

        if (length(matched) > 0) {
            return(matched[1])
        }
    }

    stop(
        paste0(
            "Could not find a required file in:\n",
            directory,
            "\nPatterns searched:\n",
            paste(patterns, collapse = "\n")
        )
    )
}

standardize_clinical <- function(
    file,
    default_project
) {

    clinical <- readr::read_csv(
        file,
        show_col_types = FALSE
    )

    sample_candidates <- c(
        "sample_id",
        "Tumor_Sample_Barcode",
        "sample_submitter_id",
        "barcode"
    )

    patient_candidates <- c(
        "patient_id",
        "case_submitter_id",
        "bcr_patient_barcode",
        "paper_patient"
    )

    project_candidates <- c(
        "TCGA_project",
        "project_id",
        "dataset"
    )

    sample_column <- intersect(
        sample_candidates,
        names(clinical)
    )[1]

    patient_column <- intersect(
        patient_candidates,
        names(clinical)
    )[1]

    project_column <- intersect(
        project_candidates,
        names(clinical)
    )[1]

    if (is.na(sample_column)) {
        stop(
            paste(
                "No sample ID column found in",
                file
            )
        )
    }

    clinical <- clinical %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
            sample_id = normalize_sample_id(
                .data[[sample_column]]
            )
        )

    if (!is.na(patient_column)) {

        clinical <- clinical %>%
            dplyr::mutate(
                patient_id = normalize_patient_id(
                    .data[[patient_column]]
                )
            )

    } else {

        clinical <- clinical %>%
            dplyr::mutate(
                patient_id = normalize_patient_id(
                    sample_id
                )
            )
    }

    if (!is.na(project_column)) {

        clinical <- clinical %>%
            dplyr::mutate(
                TCGA_project = as.character(
                    .data[[project_column]]
                )
            )

    } else {

        clinical <- clinical %>%
            dplyr::mutate(
                TCGA_project = default_project
            )
    }

    clinical %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
            TCGA_project = dplyr::case_when(
                stringr::str_detect(
                    TCGA_project,
                    "COAD"
                ) ~ "TCGA-COAD",

                stringr::str_detect(
                    TCGA_project,
                    "READ"
                ) ~ "TCGA-READ",

                stringr::str_detect(
                    TCGA_project,
                    "UCEC"
                ) ~ "TCGA-UCEC",

                default_project ==
                    "TCGA-COAD/READ" ~
                    "TCGA-COAD/READ",

                TRUE ~ default_project
            )
        ) %>%
        dplyr::distinct(
            sample_id,
            .keep_all = TRUE
        )
}

read_gsva_matrix <- function(
    file,
    pathway_project
) {

    gsva_raw <- readr::read_csv(
        file,
        show_col_types = FALSE
    )

    first_column <- names(gsva_raw)[1]

    first_values <- as.character(
        gsva_raw[[first_column]]
    )

    pathway_rows <- sum(
        stringr::str_detect(
            first_values,
            "^HALLMARK_"
        ),
        na.rm = TRUE
    )

    pathway_columns <- sum(
        stringr::str_detect(
            names(gsva_raw),
            "^HALLMARK_"
        ),
        na.rm = TRUE
    )

    if (pathway_rows > pathway_columns) {

        pathway_names <- gsva_raw[[first_column]]

        gsva_matrix <- gsva_raw %>%
            dplyr::select(
                -dplyr::all_of(first_column)
            ) %>%
            as.data.frame()

        rownames(gsva_matrix) <- pathway_names

        gsva_matrix <- as.matrix(gsva_matrix)

        storage.mode(gsva_matrix) <- "numeric"

        gsva <- as.data.frame(
            t(gsva_matrix),
            check.names = FALSE
        ) %>%
            tibble::rownames_to_column(
                "sample_id"
            )

    } else {

        gsva <- gsva_raw

        sample_candidates <- c(
            "sample_id",
            "Tumor_Sample_Barcode",
            "sample",
            first_column
        )

        sample_column <- intersect(
            sample_candidates,
            names(gsva)
        )[1]

        gsva <- gsva %>%
            dplyr::rename(
                sample_id =
                    dplyr::all_of(sample_column)
            )
    }

    gsva %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
            sample_id = normalize_sample_id(
                sample_id
            ),
            patient_id = normalize_patient_id(
                sample_id
            ),
            pathway_project = pathway_project
        ) %>%
        dplyr::distinct(
            sample_id,
            .keep_all = TRUE
        )
}

safe_kruskal <- function(
    data,
    group_column
) {

    usable <- data %>%
        dplyr::filter(
            !is.na(pathway_score),
            !is.na(.data[[group_column]])
        )

    number_groups <- dplyr::n_distinct(
        usable[[group_column]]
    )

    if (
        nrow(usable) < 3 ||
        number_groups < 2
    ) {
        return(
            tibble::tibble(
                statistic = NA_real_,
                p.value = NA_real_,
                parameter = NA_real_,
                method = "Insufficient groups"
            )
        )
    }

    formula_object <- stats::as.formula(
        paste(
            "pathway_score ~",
            group_column
        )
    )

    broom::tidy(
        stats::kruskal.test(
            formula_object,
            data = usable
        )
    )
}

safe_wilcox <- function(
    data,
    group1,
    group2
) {

    subset_data <- data %>%
        dplyr::filter(
            comparison_group %in%
                c(
                    group1,
                    group2
                ),
            !is.na(pathway_score)
        ) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
            comparison_group =
                droplevels(
                    factor(
                        comparison_group
                    )
                )
        )

    n1 <- sum(
        subset_data$comparison_group ==
            group1
    )

    n2 <- sum(
        subset_data$comparison_group ==
            group2
    )

    if (
        n1 < 2 ||
        n2 < 2
    ) {
        return(
            tibble::tibble(
                group1 = group1,
                group2 = group2,
                n_group1 = n1,
                n_group2 = n2,
                statistic = NA_real_,
                p.value = NA_real_
            )
        )
    }

    test <- stats::wilcox.test(
        pathway_score ~ comparison_group,
        data = subset_data,
        exact = FALSE
    )

    tibble::tibble(
        group1 = group1,
        group2 = group2,
        n_group1 = n1,
        n_group2 = n2,
        statistic = unname(
            test$statistic
        ),
        p.value = test$p.value
    )
}

    ),
    c(
        "Known recurrent POLE hotspot",
        "Other POLE/POLD1 alteration"
    )
)

pairwise_non_mss_tmbh <- non_mss_tmbh_long %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
        comparison_group =
            polymerase_status
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
        cancer_group,
        pathway,
        pathway_label
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_modify(
        function(.x, .y) {

            purrr::map_dfr(
                polymerase_pairs,
                function(pair) {
                    safe_wilcox(
                        .x,
                        pair[1],
                        pair[2]
                    )
                }
            )
        }
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
        p_adjusted =
            p.adjust(
                p.value,
                method = "BH"
            )
    )

readr::write_csv(
    pairwise_non_mss_tmbh,
    file.path(
        table_dir,
        "Table_pairwise_polymerase_groups_outside_MSS_TMBH.csv"
    )
)









model_data <- analysis_all %>%
    dplyr::filter(
        !is.na(cancer_group),
        !is.na(mss_tmbh_status)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
        mss_tmbh_binary =
            factor(
                mss_tmbh_status,
                levels = c(
                    "Non-MSS/TMB-H",
                    "MSS/TMB-H"
                )
            ),

        hotspot_binary =
            factor(
                hotspot_status,
                levels = c(
                    "No known recurrent POLE hotspot",
                    "Known recurrent POLE hotspot"
                )
            ),

        cancer_group =
            factor(
                cancer_group,
                levels = c(
                    "CRC",
                    "UCEC"
                )
            )
    )

interaction_results <- purrr::map_dfr(
    required_pathways,
    function(pathway_name) {

        pathway_data <- model_data %>%
            dplyr::filter(
                !is.na(.data[[pathway_name]]),
                !is.na(mss_tmbh_binary),
                !is.na(hotspot_binary),
                !is.na(cancer_group)
            ) %>%
            dplyr::mutate(
                mss_tmbh_binary = droplevels(
                    factor(mss_tmbh_binary)
                ),
                hotspot_binary = droplevels(
                    factor(hotspot_binary)
                ),
                cancer_group = droplevels(
                    factor(cancer_group)
                )
            )

        n_mss_levels <- dplyr::n_distinct(
            pathway_data$mss_tmbh_binary
        )

        n_hotspot_levels <- dplyr::n_distinct(
            pathway_data$hotspot_binary
        )

        n_cancer_levels <- dplyr::n_distinct(
            pathway_data$cancer_group
        )

        combination_count <- pathway_data %>%
            dplyr::distinct(
                mss_tmbh_binary,
                hotspot_binary
            ) %>%
            nrow()

        
        if (
            nrow(pathway_data) < 3 ||
            n_mss_levels < 2 ||
            n_hotspot_levels < 2
        ) {
            return(
                tibble::tibble(
                    pathway = pathway_name,
                    model = NA_character_,
                    term = NA_character_,
                    estimate = NA_real_,
                    std.error = NA_real_,
                    statistic = NA_real_,
                    p.value = NA_real_,
                    conf.low = NA_real_,
                    conf.high = NA_real_,
                    n = nrow(pathway_data),
                    adjusted_r_squared = NA_real_,
                    note = paste0(
                        "Model not fitted: MSS/TMB-H levels = ",
                        n_mss_levels,
                        "; hotspot levels = ",
                        n_hotspot_levels,
                        "; cancer levels = ",
                        n_cancer_levels
                    )
                )
            )
        }

        
        can_fit_interaction <- combination_count >= 3

        formula_terms <- if (can_fit_interaction) {
            "mss_tmbh_binary * hotspot_binary"
        } else {
            "mss_tmbh_binary + hotspot_binary"
        }

        if (n_cancer_levels >= 2) {
            formula_terms <- paste(
                formula_terms,
                "+ cancer_group"
            )
        }

        model_formula <- stats::as.formula(
            paste(
                pathway_name,
                "~",
                formula_terms
            )
        )

        lm_fit <- stats::lm(
            model_formula,
            data = pathway_data
        )

        model_text <- paste(
            deparse(model_formula),
            collapse = " "
        )

        model_n <- stats::nobs(
            lm_fit
        )

        model_adj_r2 <- summary(
            lm_fit
        )$adj.r.squared

        broom::tidy(
            lm_fit,
            conf.int = TRUE
        ) %>%
            dplyr::mutate(
                pathway = pathway_name,
                model = model_text,
                n = model_n,
                adjusted_r_squared = model_adj_r2,
                note = dplyr::if_else(
                    can_fit_interaction,
                    "Interaction model fitted",
                    paste0(
                        "Interaction not fitted; only ",
                        combination_count,
                        " MSS/TMB-H × hotspot combinations were observed"
                    )
                ),
                .before = 1
            )
    }
) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(pathway) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
        p_adjusted = p.adjust(
            p.value,
            method = "BH"
        )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

readr::write_csv(
    interaction_results,
    file.path(
        table_dir,
        "Table_interaction_models_MSS_TMBH_by_POLE_hotspot.csv"
    )
)
